findings.claim: The new comment ends with a bare reference "(L71)" that is not defined anywhere in the diff. A reader of this file cannot tell what it points to (a log entry, a line, a spec row). This is a comment-clarity issue only; behaviour is unaffected.

evidence: The only changed file is a test file; the change adds t.Fatalf/t.Fatal guards on the results of frontmatterBlock and Store.Get and rewrites a comment.
The guards only turn a previously ignored setup failure into an immediate test failure; they cannot make a passing, correctly set up test fail.
The test's assertions and the production code are untouched, so no regression on previously valid input is introduced.
The claim of the comment about a scratch-edit mutation cannot be verified from the diff alone.
